description: This PHP source file defines the `EndpointCollectionResult` class within the `OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2` namespace. The class extends `AbstractEndpointResult` and implements a `normalize()` method that serializes a collection of results, depending on whether the model class implements `CollectionNormalizable`. The file is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system and serves as part of its API serialization layer.

classes.name: EndpointCollectionResult
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing a collection of endpoint results, determining if the model supports normalization of object collections, and executing the appropriate normalization method.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Serializes the collection results. Checks if the model class implements `CollectionNormalizable` and calls either `normalizeObject` or `normalizeObjectsArray` accordingly.
